verifications.note: Original failure reproduced against 6c61f2e (race: smudge ran outside bwrap in 3/3 attempts; the clone could be swapped from outside). Fixed at 1e64eb0 (fix cf13cb1): sandbox-run.sh:26-40 runs only 'git rev-parse' outside (hermetic config, --end-of-options), and the clone, checkout and command all run inside bubblewrap on a private tmpfs with the git directory bound read-only. The clean proof is 02-f141-readonly.log: with the whole filesystem, including /tmp/claude-0, read-only in an outer sandbox, the old script fails at mktemp (exit 1) and the fixed script succeeds (exit 0) with an exact checkout (candidate recomputes to a25db736652685e2), '/' and /tmp/src.git read-only inside. So the fixed wrapper creates nothing that another agent's sandboxed shell can reach, and an agent shell cannot use /proc/<pid>/root either (separate PID namespace; /proc/1/root denied). The regression test 'F-DG0-141: ...' passes in 04-test-suites.log, and prefreeze passes 10/10. The residual path through agent FILE tools via /proc/<pid>/root is a separate write-guard gap, raised as F-DG0-143 (Medium). It does not reopen the code-execution escape this finding was about.
